queued.title: Waiting to start
queued.description: This scan is in the queue. Come back in a few minutes.

running.title: Running
running.description: This scan is being collected right now.

completed_empty.title: No mentions found
completed_empty.description: The scan ran and found no mentions for this brand. The scan credit was used.

completed_partial.title: This scan stopped early
completed_partial.description: Collection stopped before the end, either because the scan reached its spending ceiling or because the data provider stopped answering. What was collected is shown below.

failed.title: This scan failed
failed.description: The scan could not finish. Nothing below is complete.
failed.refunded: The scan could not finish, so your scan credit was returned.

halt.search_provider_error: The data provider failed while searching for mentions, so nothing was collected.
halt.summary_cost_ceiling: The scan stopped before the mention-summary step because it reached its spending ceiling. The mentions collected so far are kept.
halt.summary_provider_error: The data provider failed during the mention-summary step. The mentions collected before the failure are kept.
halt.brand_digest_cost_ceiling: The scan stopped before the AI digest step because it reached its spending ceiling. The mentions and summary are kept.
halt.brand_digest_digest_failed: The AI digest could not be produced reliably. The mentions and summary are kept.
halt.scan_processing_failure: The scan stalled during processing and was closed by the system.
